'''Heterkus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Heterkus system/Legends|Heterkus system]], located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Westen]] of the [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] [[Battle of Heterkus|clashed]] with [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at Heterkus.
